Luigi Sprites: Uses the original sprites from All-Stars SMB1, with only minimal edits to Luigi's sprites.
Uses edited sprites based on All-Stars SMB3, making Luigi generally taller amongst other tweaks.
option_descs.Bonus Alignment: Used to align the character heads on the background because of parallax.
Overworld Night: Uses the original game's unique Night BG for Night Overworld levels; matching the original game.
Uses a recolor of the Day BG for Night Overworld levels; matching Super Mario Bros. Remastered.
Snow Night: Uses the original game's unique Night BG for Night Snow levels; matching the original game.
Uses a recolor of the Day BG for Night Snow levels; matching Super Mario Bros. Remastered.
Brick Physics: On Classic Physics only, Hitting Bricks works the same way it does in the original All-Stars.
On Classic Physics only, Hitting Bricks is fixed and properly sends the player down like on the NES.
